name: nova-acp-agent-scripts
description: Node subprocess scripts for the Nova ACP Agent extension. ws-server.js is CommonJS. chat-session.mjs and backends/*.mjs are ES Modules.

scripts.postinstall: bash -c 'rm -rf node_modules/.bin; rm -rf node_modules/node-pty/prebuilds/win32-* 2>/dev/null; rm -rf node_modules/node-pty/prebuilds/linux-* 2>/dev/null; rm -rf node_modules/node-pty/prebuilds/darwin-x64 2>/dev/null; chmod +x node_modules/node-pty/prebuilds/*/spawn-helper 2>/dev/null || true'
